groups.name: variables
groups.visibleRule: command = migrate || command = clean || command = info || command = validate || command = baseline || command = repair || command = undo || command = checkChanges || command = checkCode || command = checkDrift || command = checkDryrun || command = diff || command = diffText || command = generate || command = model || command = prepare || command = deploy || command = snapshot

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: Command
inputs.helpMarkDown: The flyway command to run. Commands marked (Teams) or (Enterprise) require a paid Flyway license — see the Licensing group below.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: SQL scripts directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Flyway SQL scripts directory. If empty, the root of the repository (build) or artifacts (release) is used, which is $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)

inputs.name: url
inputs.label: JDBC url
inputs.helpMarkDown: The jdbc url must follow standard format. These formats can be found on Flyway documentation. [Ex for SQL Server](https://flywaydb.org/documentation/database/sqlserver). But first be sure [your database is supported](https://flywaydb.org/documentation/commandline/#jdbc-drivers). Not needed for commands that don't connect to a database (init, add, auth, list-engines).

inputs.name: user
inputs.label: Database user
inputs.helpMarkDown: The user to use to connect to the database

inputs.name: password
inputs.label: Database password
inputs.helpMarkDown: The password to use to connect to the database

inputs.name: commandOptions
inputs.label: Command Options
inputs.helpMarkDown: Any additional options for the selected command such as `-input=true`. Multiple options can be provided delimited by spaces as `-option1=value -option2=value -option3=value`

inputs.name: licenseKey
inputs.label: License Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required to run Teams/Enterprise-tier commands (undo, check -dryrun, auth, check -changes, check -drift, diff, diff -text, generate, model, prepare, deploy, snapshot). Passed to flyway as `-licenseKey`. Get a key from [Redgate](https://documentation.red-gate.com/fd/licensing-164167730.html). Leave blank for Community-tier commands.
